meta.name: competitive-intel-watch
meta.description: Scheduled delta monitoring against a prior competitive snapshot. Use when tracking competitors on a cadence: material shifts only, cited evidence, battle-card update flags, runs unattended.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定时追踪竞品动态，只推送实质性变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期跟踪竞品并自动生成战报
copy.tagline_en: Track competitors on a schedule, get only material changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor competitors regularly and auto-generate battle cards

howto.what: 将之前的竞品快照作为基线，扫描自上次以来的重大变化，只输出变化清单，每条附证据链接和日期，并标注需要更新的战卡、定位等文档。若无重大变化，会明确说'本周期无重大变化'。
howto.when: 当你提供之前的竞品快照并要求监控变化时触发；也用于定期跟踪竞争对手，或没有快照时创建首个基线快照。

say.text: 用这份快照对比当前状态，报告重要变化
say.note: 输出变化清单及证据链接

say.text: 帮我每周监控这几个竞品，重点看定价和发布
say.note: 需先提供前次快照作为对比基线

say.text: 没有快照，先建立一份竞品基线
say.note: 进入基线模式，生成首份快照

howto.what_en: Uses a prior competitive snapshot as baseline, scans for material shifts since the last run, and reports only the changes with evidence (URLs and dates) plus update flags for battle cards and positioning docs. An empty changelog is a valid outcome.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply a prior competitive snapshot and ask for a delta, or when tracking competitors on a schedule. With no snapshot, it creates a baseline first.

say_en.text: Compare this snapshot to current state and report material shifts
Monitor these competitors weekly, focus on pricing and launches
No snapshot; create a competitive baseline
say_en.note: Enters baseline mode, generates first snapshot
